hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Perform a post-order tree traversal returning (is_uniform, subtree_size).

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: A subtree rooted at u is uniform in color if all child subtrees are uniform and their colors equal colors[u].

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Whenever a subtree is uniform, update the maximum observed size.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Post-order tree traversal evaluating subproblem uniformity in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Color checking each subtree independently takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) recursion stack and adjacency list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use bottom-up subtree synthesis to aggregate size and uniformity flags.
